Daily Devotional

January 26

34 My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips. (Psalms 89:34 KJV)

What a wonderful God and Father that we have, as He is not like us humans, in that when He says something it is a covenant to Him, and He will not break His covenants. This is such a wonderful truth, as it means we can have complete confidence in the Word of God, as He can not lie (Titus 1:2), and we can be assured that what He has promised, He will fulfill. We should have total faith that all the scriptures in the bible will be done just as the Lord has said. Don’t we all wish that man was that dependable?

The fact that God will not alter the things He has said should give all believers complete confidence in His Word. Since He will not alter what He has said, means that if He has anointed you, or given you a promise, then you can be assured that He will not withdraw it, or change it, as He gives it without repentance (Romans 11:29). If only us humans could have the same integrity that the Lord has, and never break our word, or change our minds, then this life would sure be much more stable and reliable. Since we are made in His image, we should try and act the same, and keep our word just like God keeps His (Matthew 5:37). Lord, help me to be that way!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
